[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant requested information about the user's internet setup, including ISP, internet plan speed, router type, number of connected devices, physical distance from the router, connection type, and recent speed test results.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided general tips to improve internet speed, including restarting the router, moving closer to the router, using a wired Ethernet connection, updating router firmware, and limiting device connections.  
[FACT] User ran a speed test and reported results: download speed 350 Mbps, upload speed 20 Mbps, ping 25 ms.  
[FACT] User paid their internet bill on January 25th and mentioned needing to call their provider to negotiate a better deal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant analyzed the speed test results, noting that the download speed was lower than expected for a 500 Mbps plan and that the upload speed was relatively slow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant identified potential causes for slower speeds, including network congestion, router configuration, distance and interference, and ISP throttling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested actionable steps, including optimizing router configuration, prioritizing devices, reducing interference, and contacting the ISP.  
[FACT] User has been experiencing slow speeds more during peak usage hours, especially when family members are using their devices simultaneously.  
[FACT] User noticed that their smart speaker seems to be consuming some bandwidth in the background.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested configuring QoS settings on the router to prioritize devices and applications that require high-bandwidth activities.
